replication.target_description: Candidate source: A=Zhu & Ratner (2015), Study 2; B=Supply level: abundant or scarce; C=Relative liking of participants' preferred snack option. Requested target: Relationship between perceived scarcity of four vegetable varieties (carrots, broccoli, cauliflower, tomatoes) and relative preference for the favorite variety and choice of that variety when selecting six vegetable pieces.
